adopt.note: Microsoft says the named actors integrated ARTEX. The framework runs on the attacker side. This is not a victim agent audit log.

plan.note: The planner, worker shell, and reporter are ARTEX roles Microsoft describes. A victim host does not record those roles unless the agent is running there.

recon.note: Microsoft describes reconnaissance, credential attacks, and web application exploitation against internet-facing systems. The profile is a web starting point, not a detector for the artex-enrich user agent.

host.note: php-fpm, httpd/apache2, and Java application servers spawning a shell are the Linux case. w3wp.exe spawning cmd.exe or PowerShell is the Windows case and is covered by the entry's Windows web-shell rule, not by this profile.

cloud.note: Failed sign-ins, added application credentials, and an application self-assigning Global Administrator are identity events. Kerberoasting and DCSync are Windows directory alerts listed alongside them.

rotate.note: Microsoft says actors change source IP and user agent when blocked and rotate VPN, proxy, and Tor. No reviewed profile in this catalog is specific to that rotation.
